jobs.description:
AI Job Summary

* Significant Business Analysis experience delivering technology, risk, cyber security or remediation initiatives.
* Translate control gaps and security findings into actionable requirements, work packages and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Must hold Australian citizenship, permanent residency or unrestricted permanent Australian work rights.

Sign up or log in to analyse my fit

### **Role Type**

Permanent • Full-time • Mid-level Senior

### **Description**

**“OTIC” means smart people doing smart work, together.**

We are a wholly owned Australian company based in Melbourne, committed to helping our clients solve complex technology challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes through exceptional consulting expertise.

Otic Group was established to provide talented technology professionals with the opportunity to work alongside some of Australia’s most recognised organisations while collaborating with highly skilled peers in a dynamic, supportive and growing consulting environment.

Our expertise spans Project Delivery, Data & Analytics, Cloud Strategy, Application Modernisation and Cybersecurity. We work with clients to address some of their most critical technology, risk and security challenges across enterprise and operational environments.

As demand for our cyber security consulting services continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced **Senior Business Analyst – Cyber Security Remediation (Critical Infrastructure & Operational Technology)** to join our permanent consulting team.

**About the Role**

This role will support a large-scale cyber security remediation program focused on business-critical and operational technology applications.

Working alongside cyber security specialists, operational technology teams, application owners, infrastructure specialists, vendors and business stakeholders, you will help drive the remediation of identified control gaps across critical systems and assets.

You will play a key role in translating security assessments, risk findings and remediation recommendations into clear requirements, actionable work packages, measurable acceptance criteria and implementation outcomes.

The role requires a highly capable and hands-on Business Analyst who can confidently engage with technical subject matter experts, challenge assumptions, analyse control effectiveness and drive remediation activities through to successful delivery and acceptance.

Experience working within Operational Technology (OT), critical infrastructure, cyber security remediation or regulated environments will be highly regarded.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Analysing cyber security assessments, remediation plans and control-gap findings to define detailed business and technical requirements.
* Working with cyber security, operational technology, infrastructure and application teams to validate current-state controls and identify remediation opportunities.
* Translating remediation activities into functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and traceability artefacts.
* Facilitating workshops across cyber security, operational, engineering and vendor teams to drive alignment, decision-making and delivery outcomes.
* Supporting remediation initiatives across critical IT and OT applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Collaborating with stakeholders to assess remediation options, implementation approaches and operational impacts.
* Developing operational processes, procedures, playbooks and governance artefacts to support sustainable security uplift outcomes.
* Supporting risk assessment activities and ensuring unresolved gaps, residual risks and treatment options are appropriately documented and understood.
* Partnering with delivery teams to ensure requirements remain aligned throughout design, implementation, testing, evidence collection and acceptance.
* Driving remediation outcomes rather than simply documenting requirements, ensuring initiatives progress through to closure and measurable control uplift.

**What We’re Looking For**

We’re seeking a Senior Business Analyst with strong cyber security remediation experience and the ability to operate comfortably in complex technical environments.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* Significant Business Analysis experience delivering technology, risk, cyber security or remediation initiatives.
* Proven experience translating control gaps, security findings and remediation recommendations into actionable requirements and deliverables.
* Strong requirements elicitation, process analysis, documentation and acceptance criteria development skills.
* Experience validating current-state controls and working with subject matter experts to identify practical remediation approaches.
* Excellent workshop facilitation skills and the ability to drive technical discussions towards clear outcomes and decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities, including experience working across security teams, operational stakeholders, vendors and executive audiences.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with the ability to distinguish remediation activities from risk treatment and risk acceptance decisions.
* A delivery-focused approach with proven experience supporting initiatives through implementation, testing, evidence gathering and control acceptance.
* Exceptional communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language.

**Highly Desirable Experience**

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be highly regarded:

* Operational Technology (OT) environments.
* Critical infrastructure organisations and regulated industries.
* Security of Critical Infrastructure (SOCI) Act compliance initiatives.
* Critical Infrastructure Risk Management Program (CIRMP) activities.
* Industrial control systems and production environments.
* Enterprise cyber security uplift and control-remediation programs.
* Security audit and comp

### **Role Type**

Permanent • Full-time • Mid-level Senior

### **Description**

**“OTIC” means smart people doing smart work, together.**

We are a wholly owned Australian company based in Melbourne, committed to helping our clients design, secure and modernise technology platforms that unlock value across their business.

Otic Group was founded to give talented technology professionals the opportunity to work alongside some of Australia’s most recognised organisations while collaborating with exceptionally skilled peers in a highly supportive, ambitious and fast-growing environment.

Our expertise spans Project Delivery, Data & Analytics, Cloud Strategy, Application Modernisation and Cybersecurity, with consultants working on complex programs that deliver meaningful and measurable outcomes for our clients.

As demand for our cyber and technology transformation services continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced **Senior Business Analyst – Cyber Incident Remediation** to join our permanent consulting team.

**About the Role**

This role sits at the intersection of cyber security, business transformation and technology delivery.

You will play a key role in driving remediation initiatives arising from cyber incidents, security assessments, audits and risk reviews. Working across multiple technology and business teams, you will translate findings into clear business and technical requirements, remediation backlogs, measurable acceptance criteria and successful delivery outcomes.

The scope of work spans enterprise platforms including Salesforce CRM, Marketing Cloud, Tableau, Enterprise Data Platforms, Microsoft 365 and identity and access management solutions. You will work closely with cyber security specialists, architects, platform engineers, application owners, data teams and senior business stakeholders to uplift security controls and strengthen governance practices across the organisation.

This is an ideal opportunity for a Senior Business Analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, challenging assumptions and driving outcomes in large-scale, fast-paced environments.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Translating cyber incident findings, security assessments and audit recommendations into actionable business and technical requirements.
* Leading requirements elicitation workshops across business, cyber and technology teams.
* Defining remediation actions, user stories, traceability artefacts and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Conducting current-state and future-state analysis, process mapping and gap assessments.
* Working across Salesforce, identity and access management, Microsoft 365 governance, data platforms and monitoring capabilities to improve security controls.
* Supporting Agile delivery teams through backlog management, refinement sessions, testing and UAT activities.
* Identifying control gaps and working with stakeholders to drive agreed remediation outcomes.
* Collaborating with platform and engineering teams to implement sustainable solutions aligned to security and governance objectives.

**What We’re Looking For**

You will bring extensive Business Analysis experience gained across complex enterprise technology environments, along with a strong background delivering cyber security remediation or security uplift initiatives.

We’re particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* 10+ years of Business Analysis experience delivering large-scale technology transformation programs.
* Proven experience delivering cyber security remediation, security uplift, risk management or control improvement initiatives.
* Strong capability translating incident findings, audit recommendations and security assessments into clear requirements and implementation plans.
* Experience working with Identity & Access Management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access management and least-privilege principles.
* Advanced requirements elicitation, process modelling, gap analysis and acceptance criteria definition skills.
* Experience defining requirements for security logging, monitoring, detection and reporting capabilities.
* Strong understanding of data governance, information protection, privacy obligations and management of sensitive information.
* The ability to engage effectively with cyber security specialists, architects, engineers, data teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong Agile delivery experience, including user stories, backlog development, requirements traceability and test support.
* A proactive, self-starting approach with the confidence to challenge assumptions, identify risks and drive outcomes with minimal direction.

**Highly Desirable Experience**

Exposure to one or more of the following will be highly regarded:

* Salesforce CRM and/or Marketing Cloud security and access management.
* Microsoft 365 governance and Microsoft Purview.
* SIEM, SOC or enterprise security monitoring environments.
* IAM, PAM, passwordless authentication and passkey implementations.
* Tableau, enterprise data platforms or analytics environments.
* Security incident response programs or regulator/audit-driven remediation initiatives.

**Why Join Otic?**

At Otic, you’ll work alongside highly capable consultants who are passionate about delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients. You’ll gain exposure to complex enterprise environments, leading technologies and challenging transformation initiatives while being supported by a team that genuinely values collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
